purpose: Reproducible pre-launch dataset for catalog media contract tests. Every case replicates a REAL production row shape or a real failure class measured in the 2026-10-18 root-cause session (54 product_images rows, 12 products, live curl probes of every URL class). URLs are fixture material for contract tests, NOT verified inventory claims about the third-party hosts.

provenance.measured_by: session 2026-10-18 (Arena agent), read-only queries + bounded HTTP probes
provenance.prod_db: Neon production product_images: 54 rows, all storage_key in provider:photo_id:ratio:role shape, 0 in products/<id>/<file> ingest shape (counted via SQL, read-only)
provenance.prod_cdn_probe: representative public_url values returned HTTP 200 image/jpeg with Range support (206) from the same network that renders VTON fetches
provenance.local_dev_db: product_images = 0 rows; explains why the defect was invisible locally and red in production

cases.evidence: The intended final state after bucket ingestion; pinned by test_product_media.py since PR #336.
Exact prod row id 224-228 family; live 200 image/jpeg measured twice this session; CSP img-src allowlists images.pexels.com (vercel.json, read this session).
Prod row (product silk-jacquard-evening-necktie); images.unsplash.com on CSP allowlist.

Prod row; static file served 200 in production this session. Generated AI illustrations stay labelled source_type=generated and must never be presented as verified product photos (plan rule, product_image_plan_2026-10-09.json).
No URL may be invented; the page falls back to the legacy column and HonestProductImage shows the localized unavailable state only when nothing at all can be served.
Mixed content + CSP img-src (https-only hosts) would block it at the browser; rejected at the derivation layer instead so the fallback is deterministic.
Protocol-relative values are never trustworthy; must not reach an tag.
Even if a row smuggled a dot-segment key, the route pattern rejects it before any query (test_product_media.py refusal matrix; database is the ACL).

expect.note: Two surfaces: derivation would emit the route for ANY row with an ingest-shaped key (a registered row is the ACL); the ROUTE re-checks its own registry and 404s when no row exists. This case constrains the route (see the refusal matrix); it is not a derivation expectation.

cases.evidence: Key pattern alone is not enough: no row registered -> 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
Registered in the DB but absent from the bucket: 404 + operator-visible log line naming the key (media_controller design constraint 3), never a blank 200.

repair_product_images.verify_plan_against_upstream records per-rendition HTTP status; a 404 rendition must never be written into products.thumbnail_url/images or become a registry row ('never persist unverified URLs').
Hotlink/permission failures are a real ingestion outcome; classified and refused, not retried into the canonical tables.
Requests are bounded (timeout + single bounded retry window); 429 must not degrade into silently writing the unverified URL.

A 200 whose body is an error page is not decodable image content; liveness checks require image content-type (measured near-miss this session: pexels clamp URLs with bad params still return 1 KB images — size/type must be checked, not just status).
Products with no legacy images and no registry rows must keep the honest placeholder; substituting an unrelated garment photo is a trust defect (plan rule).

products_note.sleeve_length: 0040 added products.sleeve_length (nullable). Pre-launch expectation: outerwear products carry long/short/three_quarter; products with no sleeves keep null so the VTON sleeve gate never claims data it lacks.
